summary.en: The greatest Kushan ruler, Kanishka governed an empire from the Oxus to the Ganges from Purushapura (Peshawar). A patron of Buddhism, he is linked by tradition to the Fourth Buddhist Council and to Gandhara and Mathura art.
summary.zh: 贵霜帝国最伟大的君主，以布路沙布逻（白沙瓦）为都，统治从阿姆河到恒河的广大地域。他护持佛教，传说与第四次佛经结集以及犍陀罗、秣菟罗艺术相关。

label.zh: 其纪元元年（罗巴塔克铭文）
定都布路沙布逻，建大塔

label.en: Mathura, southern seat of Kushan power
label.zh: 秣菟罗，贵霜南方重镇
克什米尔：第四次结集（传说）

sources.title: Harry Falk, “The yuga of Sphujiddhvaja and the era of the Kuṣāṇas”, Silk Road Art and Archaeology 7 (2001)

note: Birth and death years are not recorded. born 100 assumes he was an adult when his era began in 127 (Falk); died 150 is the end of a reign of about 23 regnal years (his last known year, 23). Wikidata’s 78–144 reflects the older equation of his era with the Shaka era of 78 CE. Stop years are approximate.

name.zh: 旃陀罗笈多二世（超日王）

summary.en: Chandragupta II extended Gupta rule to western India by defeating the Western Kshatrapas, and his reign is remembered as a high point of classical Sanskrit culture; the Chinese pilgrim Faxian travelled through his realm.
summary.zh: 旃陀罗笈多二世击败西部总督（西萨特拉普），将笈多统治扩展至西印度；其在位时期被视为古典梵语文化的鼎盛期，中国僧人法显曾游历其境。

label.zh: 于华氏城即位
乌达耶吉里石窟铭文（笈多纪元82年）

label.en: Conquest of the Western Kshatrapas; Ujjain
label.zh: 征服西部总督，取乌贾因
去世，鸠摩罗笈多一世继位

sources.title: Upinder Singh, A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India (2008)

note: Reign c. 375/380–415. His birth is not recorded; c. 350 is an estimate that makes him an adult at his accession and old enough to campaign against the Western Kshatrapas c. 395–409. Wikidata gives only 5th-century precision.

summary.en: Aryabhata’s Āryabhaṭīya (499) compressed arithmetic, algebra, trigonometry and astronomy into 121 verses, proposing a rotating Earth and explaining eclipses by shadows; it founded a major school of Indian astronomy.
summary.zh: 阿耶波多的《阿耶波多历书》（499年）以121颂概括算术、代数、三角与天文学，提出地球自转并以阴影解释日月食，开创了印度天文学的重要学派。

label.zh: 出生（出生地有争议）
在拘苏摩补罗写成《阿耶波多历书》
据传与那烂陀相关

note: His birth year follows his own statement of his age in 499; the death year (c. 550) and Nalanda link are traditional.

summary.en: Harsha united much of north India from Kannauj after the Gupta collapse. A patron of Buddhism and himself a dramatist, he hosted Xuanzang, and his deeds are recorded in Bana’s Harshacharita.
summary.zh: 笈多王朝瓦解后，戒日王以曲女城为中心统一北印度大部。他崇奉佛教，本人亦是剧作家，曾接待玄奘，其事迹见于波那的《戒日王传》。

label.zh: 于塔内萨尔即位
以曲女城为都

label.en: Checked by Pulakeshin II on the Narmada
label.zh: 在讷尔默达河受阻于补罗稽舍二世

label.en: Religious assembly at Kannauj with Xuanzang
label.zh: 在曲女城召开有玄奘出席的大会
在钵逻耶伽举行五年一度的布施大会
卒于曲女城

sources.title: Bana, Harshacharita (tr. E. B. Cowell & F. W. Thomas, 1897)
Xuanzang, Da Tang Xiyu Ji, tr. Samuel Beal (1884)

note: The Narmada battle is dated 618–619 or c. 630s by different scholars.

summary.en: Son of Rajaraja I, Rajendra carried Chola power to its peak: he conquered Sri Lanka, marched to the Ganges, founded Gangaikonda Cholapuram and sent a fleet against Srivijaya in Southeast Asia.
summary.zh: 罗阇罗阇一世之子，拉金德拉将朱罗王朝推向巅峰：征服斯里兰卡，北进至恒河，建立新都恒伽贡达朱罗补罗，并派舰队远征东南亚的室利佛逝。

label.zh: 在坦贾武尔任共治者
完成对斯里兰卡的征服
北征抵达恒河
新都恒伽贡达朱罗补罗

去世

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, The Cōḻas, 2nd ed. (1955)

note: His birth is not recorded. c. 975 is an estimate: he was named co-regent in 1012 and had already led armies for his father against the Western Chalukyas in the early 1000s, so he was probably born in the 970s. Wikidata gives only decade precision.

summary.en: Shankara’s commentaries on the Upanishads, Bhagavad Gita and Brahma Sutras made Advaita (non-dual) Vedanta the most influential school of Hindu philosophy; tradition credits him with founding monastic seats at the four corners of India.
summary.zh: 商羯罗对《奥义书》《薄伽梵歌》和《梵经》的注疏使不二论吠檀多成为印度教最有影响的哲学派别；传说他在印度四方创立了四大修道院。

label.zh: 生于喀拉拉的卡拉迪

label.en: Becomes disciple of Govinda at Omkareshwar
label.zh: 在奥姆卡雷什瓦尔拜师乔宾达
在瓦拉纳西讲学
创立斯林格里修道院
创立普里修道院
创立德瓦尔卡修道院
创立乔希马特修道院
据传卒于凯达尔纳特

sources.title: Natalia Isayeva, Shankara and Indian Philosophy (1993)

note: The dates 788–820 are traditional (Wikidata follows them); many scholars prefer c. 700–750. The itinerary comes from later hagiographies.

summary.en: Alauddin seized the Delhi throne in 1296, repelled repeated Mongol invasions, imposed price controls and land-revenue reforms, and sent his general Malik Kafur on raids deep into the Deccan and Tamil south.
summary.zh: 阿拉乌丁于1296年夺取德里王位，多次击退蒙古入侵，推行物价管制和田赋改革，并派大将马利克·卡富尔深入德干和泰米尔南方征掠。

label.zh: 任卡拉总督
袭掠德瓦吉里
在德里夺取王位
在基利击退蒙古人
攻陷吉多尔
卒于德里

summary.en: A Timurid prince from Fergana who lost Samarkand to the Uzbeks, Babur ruled Kabul before invading India and defeating Ibrahim Lodi at Panipat in 1526. His candid Turkic memoir, the Baburnama, is a classic of autobiography.
summary.zh: 巴布尔是出身费尔干纳的帖木儿王族，失去撒马尔罕后据有喀布尔，1526年入侵印度并在帕尼帕特击败易卜拉欣·洛迪。他以察合台突厥语写成的坦率回忆录《巴布尔回忆录》是自传文学经典。

label.zh: 生于费尔干纳的安集延
首次攻占撒马尔罕
夺取喀布尔
帕尼帕特大捷
在坎瓦击败拉纳·桑加

label.en: Dies at Agra (later buried in Kabul)
label.zh: 卒于阿格拉（后葬喀布尔）

sources.title: John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)

summary.en: Akbar expanded the Mughal Empire across north India and the northern Deccan, built a centralised mansabdari administration, drew Rajput nobles into his service and promoted religious tolerance through debates and his policy of sulh-i kul (universal peace).
summary.zh: 阿克巴将莫卧儿帝国扩展至北印度及德干北部，建立中央集权的曼沙布达尔官制，吸纳拉其普特贵族效力，并通过宗教辩论和“普遍和平”政策推行宗教宽容。

label.zh: 生于信德的乌默尔果德
在卡拉瑙尔加冕
第二次帕尼帕特战役
新都法塔赫布尔西格里
征服古吉拉特
宫廷驻拉合尔（至1598年）
攻取德干的阿西尔加尔
卒于阿格拉

sources.title: Abu'l-Fazl, Akbarnama and Ain-i-Akbari (tr. H. Beveridge; H. Blochmann & H. S. Jarrett)
John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)

summary.en: Under Shah Jahan Mughal court culture reached its most splendid, producing the Taj Mahal, the Peacock Throne and the new capital Shahjahanabad at Delhi; he was deposed by his son Aurangzeb and died a prisoner in Agra Fort.
summary.zh: 沙贾汗时期莫卧儿宫廷文化最为辉煌，建造了泰姬陵、孔雀宝座以及德里的新都沙贾汉纳巴德；他后被其子奥朗则布废黜，囚死于阿格拉堡。

label.zh: 生于拉合尔

label.en: Campaigns in the Deccan from Burhanpur
label.zh: 以布尔汉布尔为基地征讨德干
在阿格拉登基
开始兴建泰姬陵
迁都沙贾汉纳巴德（德里）

label.en: Deposed and confined in Agra Fort
label.zh: 被废黜，囚于阿格拉堡
卒于阿格拉堡

sources.title: John F. Richards, The Mughal Empire (New Cambridge History of India I.5, 1993)
Ebba Koch, The Complete Taj Mahal (2006)

summary.en: Shivaji carved an independent Maratha state out of the Bijapur Sultanate and Mughal Deccan through hill-fort warfare and raids, escaped Mughal custody at Agra, and was crowned Chhatrapati at Raigad in 1674.
summary.zh: 希瓦吉以山堡战和突袭从比贾布尔苏丹国与莫卧儿德干领地中开辟出独立的马拉塔国家，曾从阿格拉的莫卧儿软禁中脱身，1674年在赖格尔加冕为“查特拉帕蒂”。

label.zh: 生于希夫内里堡
夺取托尔纳堡
在普拉塔普加尔击杀阿夫扎尔汗
洗劫苏拉特
从阿格拉的莫卧儿软禁中逃脱
在赖格尔加冕为查特拉帕蒂
南征，攻取金吉
卒于赖格尔

sources.title: Stewart Gordon, The Marathas 1600–1818 (New Cambridge History of India II.4, 1993)

note: Birth date disputed: 19 February 1630 is the date officially adopted by the Maharashtra government and followed by many historians; Jadunath Sarkar and Wikidata prefer 1627, and Britannica gives both.

summary.en: Son of Hyder Ali, Tipu modernised Mysore’s army, used iron-cased rockets and sought French alliance against the East India Company; he died defending his capital Seringapatam in 1799.
summary.zh: 海德尔·阿里之子，蒂普推动迈索尔军队现代化，使用铁壳火箭，并谋求与法国结盟对抗东印度公司；1799年在保卫都城塞林伽巴丹时战死。

label.zh: 生于德瓦纳哈利
波利卢尔大捷
在塞林伽巴丹继承海德尔·阿里
签订《门格洛尔条约》

label.en: Cedes half his realm (Treaty of Seringapatam)
label.zh: 割让半壁国土（《塞林伽巴丹条约》）

label.en: Killed in the storming of Seringapatam
label.zh: 在塞林伽巴丹陷落时战死

sources.title: Kate Brittlebank, Tipu Sultan’s Search for Legitimacy (1997)

summary.en: Ranjit Singh united the Sikh misls into a Punjab kingdom with its capital at Lahore, built a European-trained army and extended his rule to Multan, Kashmir and Peshawar while keeping peace with the British.
summary.zh: 兰吉特·辛格将锡克各米斯尔统一为以拉合尔为都的旁遮普王国，建立欧式训练的军队，将统治扩展至木尔坦、克什米尔和白沙瓦，同时与英国保持和平。

label.zh: 生于古杰兰瓦拉
攻取拉合尔

label.zh: 与英国签订《阿姆利则条约》

吞并白沙瓦

name.zh: 詹西女王拉克希米·巴伊

role.en: Queen of Jhansi, leader in the 1857 rebellion

summary.en: Widowed queen of Jhansi, whose state the Company annexed under the doctrine of lapse, Lakshmibai led its defence in 1858 and died fighting near Gwalior, becoming an enduring heroine of Indian nationalism.
summary.zh: 詹西王后寡居后，其土邦被东印度公司以“无嗣失权”为由吞并；1858年她领导詹西抵抗，在瓜廖尔附近战死，成为印度民族主义的不朽女英雄。

label.zh: 生于瓦拉纳西
嫁给詹西王公

label.zh: 起义期间执掌詹西

在瓜廖尔附近战死

sources.title: Harleen Singh, The Rani of Jhansi: Gender, History, and Fable in India (2014)

role.en: Leader of the Indian independence movement

summary.en: A lawyer who developed satyagraha (non-violent resistance) in South Africa, Gandhi led mass campaigns of non-cooperation and civil disobedience against British rule in India and was assassinated by a Hindu nationalist in 1948.
summary.zh: 甘地原为律师，在南非发展出“非暴力抵抗”理念，回国后领导反对英国统治的群众性不合作与文明不服从运动，1948年被一名印度教民族主义者刺杀。

label.zh: 生于博尔本德尔
赴伦敦学习法律

label.en: South Africa; thrown off a train at Pietermaritzburg
label.zh: 在南非彼得马里茨堡被逐下火车

label.en: Returns to India; ashram at Ahmedabad
label.zh: 回到印度，在艾哈迈达巴德建修道院
昌巴兰非暴力抵抗运动
食盐进军抵达丹迪
在孟买提出“退出印度”决议
在诺阿卡利开展和平之行
在德里遇刺

M. K. Gandhi, An Autobiography: The Story of My Experiments with Truth (1927–29)

summary.en: A Congress leader imprisoned repeatedly under British rule, Nehru served as India’s first prime minister from 1947 to 1964, shaping its parliamentary democracy, secular constitution, planned economy and non-aligned foreign policy.
summary.zh: 尼赫鲁是多次遭英国当局监禁的国大党领袖，1947年至1964年任印度首任总理，奠定了印度的议会民主、世俗宪政、计划经济和不结盟外交。

label.zh: 生于阿拉哈巴德
就读哈罗公学，后入剑桥

label.zh: 以律师身份回到阿拉哈巴德

summary.en: Bengali poet, novelist, songwriter and painter, Tagore became the first non-European Nobel laureate in literature (1913) for Gitanjali, founded Visva-Bharati at Santiniketan, and wrote the national anthems of India and Bangladesh.
summary.zh: 孟加拉诗人、小说家、作曲家和画家，泰戈尔凭《吉檀迦利》于1913年成为首位获诺贝尔文学奖的非欧洲人；他在圣蒂尼克坦创办国际大学，并创作了印度和孟加拉国的国歌。

label.zh: 生于加尔各答乔拉桑戈

summary.en: A Bombay barrister who first worked for Hindu–Muslim unity, Jinnah led the All-India Muslim League to demand a separate Muslim homeland and became Pakistan’s first governor-general in 1947, dying a year later.
summary.zh: 真纳原为孟买律师，早年致力于印穆团结，后领导全印穆斯林联盟争取建立独立的穆斯林家园，1947年出任巴基斯坦首任总督，次年去世。

拉合尔决议

summary.en: Born at Talwandi (now Nankana Sahib) in Punjab, Nanak taught devotion to one formless God, equality regardless of caste or creed, and honest work. After long journeys he settled at Kartarpur on the Ravi, where the first Sikh community formed; his hymns are the core of the Guru Granth Sahib.
summary.zh: 那纳克生于旁遮普的塔尔万迪（今南卡纳萨希卜），倡导虔信唯一无形之神，主张不分种姓与信仰的平等和诚实劳动。长期游历后，他定居拉维河畔的卡尔塔普尔，形成第一个锡克教社群；他的赞美诗构成《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》的核心。

label.zh: 生于塔尔万迪（今南卡纳萨希卜）
在苏尔坦布尔洛迪得道
定居卡尔塔普尔
卒于卡尔塔普尔

sources.title: W. H. McLeod, Guru Nanak and the Sikh Religion (1968)

note: The journeys (udasis) and the dates of his Sultanpur revelation and of the founding of Kartarpur (given as 1504 or c. 1520) rest on later janamsakhi traditions.

summary.en: A Rajput princess of Merta married into the ruling house of Mewar, Mirabai devoted herself to Krishna against family expectations and composed passionate devotional songs in Rajasthani and Braj. Legends of persecution surround her, and she is said to have ended her days at Dwarka. Her bhajans are still widely sung.
summary.zh: 米拉巴伊是梅尔塔的拉杰普特公主，嫁入梅瓦尔王室，不顾家族期望专心敬奉黑天，用拉贾斯坦语和布拉吉语创作热烈的虔信歌曲。关于她遭受迫害的传说众多，据称她晚年在德瓦尔卡辞世。她的颂歌至今广为传唱。

label.en: Born in the Merta Rathore family
label.zh: 生于梅尔塔的拉托尔家族

label.en: Marries Bhoj Raj of Mewar at Chittor

summary.en: Largely self-taught, Ramanujan worked as a clerk in Madras while filling notebooks with results on infinite series, continued fractions and number theory. In 1913 he wrote to G. H. Hardy, who brought him to Cambridge; elected a Fellow of the Royal Society in 1918, he died at 32 in Kumbakonam.
summary.zh: 拉马努金基本自学成才，在马德拉斯任职员时在笔记本中写下大量关于无穷级数、连分数和数论的结果。1913年他致信哈代，后者邀他赴剑桥；1918年当选英国皇家学会会员，1920年在贡伯戈讷姆去世，年仅32岁。

label.zh: 生于伊罗德
在贡伯戈讷姆长大

抵达剑桥大学三一学院

summary.en: The second Gupta emperor, whose conquests are listed in a Sanskrit eulogy carved on the Ashokan pillar now at Allahabad. He annexed much of the Ganges plain, made the kings of the south and the frontiers his tributaries and issued coins showing himself playing the veena.
summary.zh: 笈多王朝第二位皇帝，其武功被刻在今存于阿拉哈巴德的阿育王石柱上的梵文颂词里。他吞并了恒河平原大部，使南方和边疆诸王纳贡称臣，并铸有自己弹奏维纳琴形象的钱币。

label.zh: 于华氏城即位
征伐雅利安伐尔多：憍赏弥一带
南征抵达建志

埃兰：铭文与毗湿奴神庙

sources.title: J. F. Fleet, Corpus Inscriptionum Indicarum III (1888), no. 1: Allahabad pillar inscription
Upinder Singh, A History of Ancient and Early Medieval India (2008), ch. 9
A. L. Basham, The Wonder That Was India (1954)

note: No source records his birth. c. 318 is an inference, not a documented date: he succeeded his father Chandragupta I (whose accession opens the Gupta era, 319/320) as an adult chosen before the court, most often dated c. 335 (Basham c. 335–376; Altekar c. 330–370), so a birth in the late 310s fits; the same figure is the one in common reference use. Later starts proposed for his reign (c. 350, Goyal) would push it later. Death c. 375 follows Singh; Britannica has c. 380. Stop years are approximate and the order of the campaigns is not known.

summary.en: The greatest poet of classical Sanskrit, author of the play Abhijnanashakuntalam, the epics Raghuvamsha and Kumarasambhava and the lyric Meghaduta (The Cloud Messenger). He probably worked in the Gupta age; little is known of his life beyond legend.
summary.zh: 古典梵语文学最伟大的诗人，著有戏剧《沙恭达罗》、叙事诗《罗怙世系》《鸠摩罗出世》和抒情长诗《云使》。他很可能生活在笈多时代，生平除传说外所知甚少。

label.en: Ujjain, the city he praises in the Meghaduta (court of “Vikramaditya” by tradition)
label.zh: 优禅尼：《云使》中称颂的城市（传说为“超日王”宫廷所在）

label.en: Ramagiri (Ramtek), opening scene of the Meghaduta; Vakataka court link (Mirashi hypothesis)
label.zh: 罗摩山（拉姆泰克）：《云使》开篇之地；与伐卡陀伽宫廷的联系（米拉希假说）
笈多宫廷环境（旃陀罗笈多二世至鸠摩罗笈多一世）

sources.title: V. V. Mirashi & N. R. Navlekar, Kālidāsa: Date, Life and Works (1969)
Barbara Stoler Miller (ed.), Theater of Memory: The Plays of Kālidāsa (1984)

note: Kalidasa’s dates are inferred from his style and allusions; most scholars place his career c. 400 CE under Chandragupta II. born 370 and died 450 are therefore a bracket around that working life, not documented dates, and the stops are traditional associations, not documented visits.

summary.en: The greatest Chalukya king of Badami, who stopped Harsha’s advance at the Narmada and fought the Pallavas of Kanchi. Xuanzang visited his kingdom and praised its soldiers; Pulakeshin died when the Pallava king Narasimhavarman I captured Vatapi in 642.
summary.zh: 巴达米遮娄其王朝最伟大的国王，在讷尔默达河阻止戒日王南进，并与建志的帕拉瓦王朝交战。玄奘到访其国，称赞其兵士骁勇；642年帕拉瓦国王那罗辛哈跋摩一世攻陷伐陀比，补罗稽舍阵亡。

label.en: Wins the throne at Vatapi (Badami) after civil war with his uncle Mangalesha
label.zh: 与叔父曼加勒沙内战后在伐陀比（巴达米）夺得王位
在讷尔默达河击败戒日王

label.en: Conquers Vengi; installs his brother (Eastern Chalukyas)
label.zh: 征服文吉，册立其弟（东遮娄其）

label.en: Aihole inscription of Ravikirti celebrates his victories
label.zh: 艾霍莱的拉维基尔提铭文颂扬其战功

label.en: Killed when the Pallavas take Vatapi
label.zh: 帕拉瓦军攻陷伐陀比，阵亡

sources.title: Aihole inscription of Pulakeshin II, ed. F. Kielhorn, Epigraphia Indica VI (1900)
Xuanzang, Da Tang Xiyu Ji, book 11 (Mohelacha)

note: No source records his birth. c. 590 is inferred: he was still a minor when his father Kirtivarman I died (c. 592–597), which is why his uncle Mangalesha took the throne, and he was old enough to overthrow Mangalesha c. 610. Wikidata’s 610 is his accession. The Narmada battle is dated between 612 and 634; 618 follows the existing atlas record.

summary.en: The Chola king who turned a regional Tamil kingdom into a maritime empire, conquering the Cheras, the Pandyas and northern Sri Lanka. He surveyed land revenue, recorded his deeds in standard inscriptions and built the Brihadisvara temple at Thanjavur.
summary.zh: 把一个泰米尔地方王国变成海洋帝国的朱罗国王，征服了哲罗、潘地亚和斯里兰卡北部。他丈量田赋，以统一格式的铭文记录功绩，并在坦贾武尔建造了布里哈迪希瓦拉神庙。

label.zh: 在坦贾武尔加冕

label.en: Naval victory at Kandalur Salai over the Cheras
label.zh: 在坎达卢尔萨莱海战中击败哲罗

label.en: Conquers northern Sri Lanka; Anuradhapura sacked
label.zh: 征服斯里兰卡北部，洗劫阿努拉德普勒

label.en: Polonnaruwa made the Chola provincial capital (Jananathamangalam)
label.zh: 以波隆纳鲁沃为朱罗行省首府
为布里哈迪希瓦拉神庙举行奉献礼

label.en: Dies; his son Rajendra I succeeds
label.zh: 去世，其子罗金陀罗一世继位

sources.title: K. A. Nilakanta Sastri, The Cōḷas (2nd ed., 1955)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Great Living Chola Temples

note: Birth year is uncertain (c. 947). The Polonnaruwa stop is a conquest by his forces, not a documented royal visit.

role.zh: 毗湿奴派哲学家（限定不二论）

summary.en: The south Indian theologian who gave devotion to Vishnu a systematic philosophy, qualified non-dualism, in his commentary Shri Bhashya. Leader of the Srirangam temple community, he reorganised its worship and, by tradition, spent years in exile in the Hoysala country.
summary.zh: 南印度神学家，在注释《室利注》中为毗湿奴信仰建立了系统的哲学“限定不二论”。他领导斯里兰格姆神庙团体，改革其礼仪，据传曾在曷萨拉王国流亡多年。

label.zh: 生于斯里佩鲁姆布杜尔

label.en: Studies Vedanta at Kanchipuram under Yadavaprakasha
label.zh: 在建志补罗随耶达婆普拉卡沙学习吠檀多

label.en: Becomes head of the Srirangam temple community
label.zh: 成为斯里兰格姆神庙团体领袖

label.en: Exile at Melukote under Hoysala protection (tradition)
label.zh: 在曷萨拉庇护下流亡梅卢科特（传说）
卒于斯里兰格姆（传统年份）

sources.title: John B. Carman, The Theology of Rāmānuja (1974)

note: The traditional lifespan of 120 years (1017–1137) is doubted; some scholars prefer c. 1077–1157. The exile and the conversion of the Hoysala king Vishnuvardhana come from hagiography.

summary.en: The king who reunited Sri Lanka after decades of division, reformed the Buddhist order and built irrigation works on a scale never seen before, above all the Parakrama Samudra reservoir. The Culavamsa credits him with the saying that not one drop of rain should reach the sea without serving people.
summary.zh: 在分裂数十年后重新统一斯里兰卡的国王，整顿佛教僧团，修建了空前规模的灌溉工程，尤以波罗迦罗摩海水库为最。《小史》记载他曾说：不让一滴雨水未经造福人民就流入大海。

label.zh: 统治达基纳德萨（库鲁内格勒一带）
在波隆纳鲁沃加冕
修建波罗迦罗摩海水库

label.en: Unifies the sangha at a council in Polonnaruwa
label.zh: 在波隆纳鲁沃召集会议统一僧团
卒于波隆纳鲁沃

sources.title: K. M. de Silva, A History of Sri Lanka (rev. 2005)

note: Dates follow Geiger’s chronology; the sangha reform is dated c. 1165 and the reservoir to the 1150s–1160s.

summary.en: A Turkic slave from the steppe who rose to become the real founder of the Delhi Sultanate. He kept north India out of Chinggis Khan’s path, received investiture from the Abbasid caliph in 1229, completed the Qutb Minar and named his daughter Razia as heir.
summary.zh: 出身草原的突厥奴隶，后成为德里苏丹国的真正奠基者。他使北印度避开了成吉思汗的兵锋，1229年获阿拔斯哈里发册封，完成了顾特卜塔，并指定女儿拉齐娅为继承人。

label.en: Sold as a slave in Bukhara
label.zh: 在布哈拉被卖为奴

label.en: Bought by Qutb ud-Din Aibak in Delhi
label.zh: 在德里被库特布丁·艾伊拜克买下
任巴道恩总督（伊克塔领主）
在德里即苏丹位

label.en: Receives the Abbasid caliph’s robes of investiture
label.zh: 接受阿拔斯哈里发所赐册封礼袍

label.en: Dies; buried beside the Qutb mosque
label.zh: 去世，葬于顾特卜清真寺旁

sources.title: Minhaj-i Siraj Juzjani, Tabaqat-i Nasiri, tr. H. G. Raverty (1881)
Peter Jackson, The Delhi Sultanate: A Political and Military History (1999)

note: No contemporary source gives his birth year. c. 1180 is inferred from Minhaj’s account: he was sold as a boy, bought in Delhi by Aibak c. 1197, made amir of Gwalior after 1200 and led the Badaun contingent against the Khokhars in 1205–06, so he was probably born in the early 1180s. The 1192 found in Wikidata and Wikipedia is uncited and would make him a governor at eight. Early-career stop years are approximate.

summary.en: The only woman to rule the Delhi Sultanate. Named heir by her father Iltutmish, she took the throne in 1236 with the support of Delhi’s people, rode out unveiled at the head of her troops, and was overthrown by Turkic nobles in 1240.
summary.zh: 德里苏丹国唯一的女性统治者。她被父亲伊勒图特米什立为继承人，1236年在德里民众支持下登基，曾不戴面纱率军出征，1240年被突厥贵族推翻。

label.en: Governs Delhi during her father’s Gwalior campaign
label.zh: 其父征瓜廖尔期间代理德里政务
在德里被拥立为苏丹

label.en: Captured at Bathinda by the rebel governor Altunia, whom she marries
label.zh: 在巴廷达被叛乱总督阿尔图尼亚俘获，后与之成婚
兵败后在凯塔尔附近遇害

sources.title: Minhaj-i Siraj Juzjani, Tabaqat-i Nasiri, tr. H. G. Raverty (1881)
Peter Jackson, The Delhi Sultanate (1999), ch. 3

note: Her birth year is not recorded; c. 1205 is an estimate, since she was trusted with the government of Delhi during her father’s Gwalior campaign of 1231–32 and so was an adult by then. Her burial place is disputed between Old Delhi and Kaithal.

summary.en: A learned and restless sultan who briefly ruled almost all of India. His schemes, from moving the capital to Daulatabad to a token copper currency, ended in revolt and famine; the Moroccan traveller Ibn Battuta served as his judge in Delhi.
summary.zh: 博学而不安分的苏丹，一度统治几乎整个印度。他的种种计划，从迁都道拉塔巴德到发行铜质代币，都以叛乱和饥荒告终；摩洛哥旅行家伊本·白图泰曾在德里担任他的法官。

label.en: As prince Ulugh Khan, takes Warangal from the Kakatiyas
label.zh: 以王子乌卢格汗身份攻取卡卡提亚都城瓦朗加尔
在图格拉卡巴德即位

label.en: Moves the court and much of Delhi to Daulatabad
label.zh: 将宫廷与大批德里居民迁往道拉塔巴德

label.en: Receives Ibn Battuta and makes him qadi of Delhi
label.zh: 接见伊本·白图泰，任命他为德里法官

label.en: Dies near Thatta while pursuing a rebel in Sindh
label.zh: 在信德追剿叛军时卒于塔塔附近

sources.title: Ibn Battuta, Rihla, tr. H. A. R. Gibb, vol. III (1971)

note: His birth is not recorded; c. 1290 is an estimate based on his command of the Warangal campaigns of 1321–23 as prince Ulugh Khan.

name.zh: 桑加马格拉马的马德哈瓦

summary.en: Founder of the Kerala school of astronomy and mathematics. Later Kerala texts credit him with infinite series for the sine, cosine and arctangent and a correction term that gave π to eleven decimal places, some two centuries before similar results in Europe.
summary.zh: 喀拉拉天文与数学学派的创始人。后世喀拉拉文献把正弦、余弦和反正切的无穷级数以及可将圆周率算到小数点后十一位的修正项归功于他，比欧洲类似成果早约两个世纪。

label.zh: 桑加马格拉马（伊林贾拉库达），其家乡

label.en: Teaches Parameshvara, who carries his methods on
label.zh: 传授帕拉梅什瓦拉，后者延续其方法
最后可考的著作（约略）

sources.title: MacTutor History of Mathematics: Madhava of Sangamagramma
Kim Plofker, Mathematics in India (2009), ch. 7
K. V. Sarma, A History of the Kerala School of Hindu Astronomy (1972)

note: Only a few short works by Madhava survive; his series are known from later texts such as the Yuktibhasha and Nilakantha’s works. All stops are at his home village.

summary.en: A weaver of Varanasi whose blunt Hindi verses mocked the rituals of both Hindus and Muslims and praised a formless God within. His poems survive in the Sikh Guru Granth Sahib, the Kabir Panth’s Bijak and the songs of Rajasthani singers.
summary.zh: 瓦拉纳西的一名织工，他直率的印地语诗歌嘲讽印度教徒和穆斯林的仪式，赞颂内在的无形之神。他的诗作保存在锡克教《古鲁·格兰特·萨希卜》、格比尔派的《比贾克》和拉贾斯坦歌者的吟唱中。

label.en: Found as an infant at Lahartara tank, Varanasi (legend)
label.zh: 据传在瓦拉纳西拉哈尔塔拉池畔被拾养
在瓦拉纳西织布并作诗

label.en: Dies at Maghar, a town said to bring rebirth as a donkey
label.zh: 卒于马加尔，相传死于此地会转生为驴

sources.title: Charlotte Vaudeville, A Weaver Named Kabir (1993)
Linda Hess & Shukdev Singh, The Bijak of Kabir (2002)

note: Traditional dates run from 1398 to 1518; most scholars accept c. 1440–1518. The foundling story is legend.

summary.en: The most celebrated emperor of Vijayanagara, who defeated the Gajapatis of Odisha and the Bijapur sultan and ruled from a capital that Portuguese visitors compared to Rome. A poet himself, he wrote the Telugu Amuktamalyada and kept the eight great Telugu poets at court.
summary.zh: 毗奢耶那伽罗最负盛名的皇帝，击败奥里萨的伽阇帕蒂王朝和比贾布尔苏丹，其都城被葡萄牙访客比作罗马。他本人也是诗人，写有泰卢固语长诗《阿穆克塔马利亚达》，宫中供养泰卢固“八大诗人”。

label.zh: 在毗奢耶那伽罗（亨比）加冕

label.en: Takes the Gajapati fortress of Udayagiri
label.zh: 攻取伽阇帕蒂的乌达耶吉里要塞

label.en: Worships at Tirumala, leaving bronze portraits of himself and his queens
label.zh: 在蒂鲁马拉朝拜，留下他与王后们的铜像

label.en: Wins the battle of Raichur against Bijapur
label.zh: 在赖久尔之战中击败比贾布尔
卒于毗奢耶那伽罗

sources.title: Robert Sewell, A Forgotten Empire (Vijayanagar) (1900), incl. the chronicles of Domingo Paes and Fernão Nunes
Burton Stein, Vijayanagara (New Cambridge History of India I.2, 1989)

note: Birth year is given as 1471 in most references. The Tirumala visit year is one of several recorded visits.

summary.en: An Afghan jagirdar from Sasaram who defeated the Mughal Humayun at Chausa and Kannauj and ruled north India for five years. His reforms of the road network, coinage and land survey outlived him and were taken over by Akbar.
summary.zh: 出身萨萨拉姆的阿富汗封地领主，在乔萨和卡瑙季击败莫卧儿皇帝胡马雍，统治北印度五年。他在道路、币制和土地丈量方面的改革延续下来，被阿克巴继承。

label.en: Manages his father’s jagir at Sasaram
label.zh: 在萨萨拉姆管理其父的封地
在乔萨击败胡马雍

label.en: Routs the Mughals at Kannauj and takes Delhi
label.zh: 在卡瑙季击溃莫卧儿军，夺取德里

label.en: Begins Rohtas Fort to hold the Punjab against the Gakhars
label.zh: 修建罗赫塔斯堡以控制旁遮普、防御加卡尔人

label.en: Killed by an exploding gunpowder store at the siege of Kalinjar
label.zh: 围攻卡林贾尔时火药爆炸身亡

sources.title: Encyclopaedia Britannica: Sher Shah of Sur
Abbas Khan Sarwani, Tarikh-i Sher Shahi (c. 1580), tr. B. P. Ambashthya (1974)
UNESCO World Heritage Centre: Rohtas Fort

note: Birth year is given as 1472 or 1486 in different sources.

summary.en: The Persian-born widow who married the emperor Jahangir in 1611 and became the most powerful woman in Mughal history. Coins were struck in her name, she issued orders, hunted tigers and designed gardens and her father’s tomb at Agra.
summary.zh: 生于波斯人家庭的寡妇，1611年嫁给贾汉吉尔皇帝，成为莫卧儿历史上最有权势的女性。钱币以她的名义铸造，她亲自发布敕令、猎虎，并设计园林及其父在阿格拉的陵墓。

label.en: Born at Kandahar as her family travels to India
label.zh: 其家族前往印度途中生于坎大哈

label.en: Widowed at Bardhaman when her husband Sher Afgan is killed
label.zh: 丈夫谢尔·阿夫甘在布德万被杀，她成为寡妇
在阿格拉嫁给贾汉吉尔

label.en: Leads the counter-attack on an elephant after Mahabat Khan’s coup on the Jhelum
label.zh: 马哈巴特汗在杰赫勒姆河畔发动政变后，她乘象率军反击

label.en: Dies at Lahore; buried at Shahdara
label.zh: 卒于拉合尔，葬于沙赫达拉

sources.title: Ruby Lal, Empress: The Astonishing Reign of Nur Jahan (2018)
Jahangir, Jahangirnama, tr. W. M. Thackston (1999)

summary.en: The sixth Mughal emperor, who took the throne by defeating his brothers and imprisoning his father Shah Jahan. He extended the empire to its greatest size by conquering Bijapur and Golconda, but his long Deccan wars against the Marathas and his religious policies strained it to breaking point.
summary.zh: 第六位莫卧儿皇帝，击败诸兄弟、囚禁父亲沙贾汗后登基。他征服比贾布尔和戈尔康达，使帝国疆域达到极盛，但对马拉塔人的长期德干战争和宗教政策使帝国不堪重负。

label.zh: 生于达霍德

label.en: Viceroy of the Deccan, based at Aurangabad
label.zh: 任德干总督，驻奥兰加巴德

label.en: Defeats Dara Shikoh at Samugarh and seizes Agra
label.zh: 在萨穆加尔击败达拉·希科，夺取阿格拉
在德里正式加冕

label.en: Moves to the Deccan for the rest of his life
label.zh: 移驻德干，此后再未北返

label.en: Takes Golconda after an eight-month siege
label.zh: 围攻八个月后攻陷戈尔康达

label.en: Dies at Ahmednagar; buried simply at Khuldabad
label.zh: 卒于艾哈迈德讷格尔，简葬于库尔达巴德

sources.title: Jadunath Sarkar, History of Aurangzib, 5 vols. (1912–24)
Audrey Truschke, Aurangzeb: The Life and Legacy of India’s Most Controversial King (2017)

summary.en: The tenth Guru of the Sikhs, who became Guru at nine after the execution of his father Guru Tegh Bahadur. He founded the Khalsa in 1699, fought the hill rajas and Mughal governors, lost all four sons, and declared the scripture itself the Guru after him.
summary.zh: 锡克教第十代古鲁，父亲古鲁·德格·巴哈杜尔被处决后，九岁即成为古鲁。他于1699年创立卡尔萨，与山地王公和莫卧儿总督作战，四个儿子全部殒命，并宣布在他之后由经典本身担任古鲁。

label.zh: 生于巴特那

label.en: Becomes Guru at Anandpur after his father’s execution
label.zh: 其父被处决后在阿南德普尔成为古鲁

label.en: Founds the Khalsa at the Vaisakhi gathering
label.zh: 在拜萨基节集会上创立卡尔萨

label.en: Battle of Chamkaur; his two elder sons fall
label.zh: 查姆考尔之战，两个长子阵亡

label.en: At Talwandi Sabo (Damdama Sahib) prepares the final recension of the Guru Granth
label.zh: 在塔尔万迪·萨博（达姆达玛·萨希卜）编定《古鲁·格兰特》的定本

label.en: Dies at Nanded after a stabbing
label.zh: 在楠德德遇刺后去世

sources.title: W. H. McLeod, Historical Dictionary of Sikhism (2nd ed., 2005)
J. S. Grewal, The Sikhs of the Punjab (New Cambridge History of India II.3, rev. 1998)

summary.en: A Drukpa lama from Tibet who fled a succession dispute in 1616 and unified the valleys of Bhutan. He built the great dzongs (fortress-monasteries), defeated Tibetan invasions and created the dual system of a religious head and a civil ruler; his death was kept secret for some fifty years.
summary.zh: 来自西藏的竹巴噶举派喇嘛，1616年因法嗣之争出走，统一了不丹各河谷。他修建大型宗堡（要塞兼寺院），击退藏军入侵，创立政教分治的二元体制；他的死讯被隐瞒了约五十年。

label.en: Born near Ralung, seat of the Drukpa school in Tibet
label.zh: 生于西藏竹巴派祖寺热龙附近

label.en: Crosses into Bhutan via Laya and Gasa
label.zh: 经拉雅、加萨进入不丹
修建辛托卡宗
建普那卡宗为都

label.en: Enters a retreat at Punakha and dies; death concealed
label.zh: 在普那卡闭关并去世，死讯被隐瞒

sources.title: Karma Phuntsho, The History of Bhutan (2013), chs. 7–8
Michael Aris, Bhutan: The Early History of a Himalayan Kingdom (1979)

note: The Laya–Gasa entry route follows Bhutanese tradition.

role.en: King of Gorkha, unifier of Nepal
role.zh: 廓尔喀国王、尼泊尔统一者

summary.en: King of the small hill state of Gorkha who spent a quarter-century blockading and conquering the rich Malla kingdoms of the Kathmandu Valley. He moved his capital to Kathmandu in 1768, and his sayings (the Dibya Upadesh) called Nepal “a yam between two boulders”, China and British India.
summary.zh: 山地小国廓尔喀的国王，用四分之一个世纪封锁并征服了加德满都谷地富庶的马拉诸王国。1768年他迁都加德满都；他的训言《神圣教诲》把尼泊尔比作“夹在两块巨石之间的山药”，即中国与英属印度之间。

label.zh: 生于廓尔喀王宫
即位为廓尔喀国王

label.en: Takes Nuwakot, the gateway to the valley
label.zh: 攻取通往谷地的门户努瓦科特

label.en: Takes Kirtipur at the third attempt
label.zh: 第三次进攻终于攻取基尔蒂普尔

label.en: Enters Kathmandu during the Indra Jatra festival
label.zh: 在因陀罗节期间进入加德满都
攻取巴克塔普尔，终结马拉统治
卒于努瓦科特

sources.title: Ludwig F. Stiller, The Rise of the House of Gorkha (1973)
John Whelpton, A History of Nepal (2005), ch. 2

summary.en: A Bengali scholar of Persian, Sanskrit and English often called the father of the Bengal Renaissance. He campaigned against sati, argued for monotheism from the Upanishads, founded the Brahmo Sabha in 1828 and died in England while pleading the Mughal emperor’s case.
summary.zh: 精通波斯语、梵语和英语的孟加拉学者，常被称为“孟加拉文艺复兴之父”。他反对萨蒂殉夫习俗，依据奥义书倡导一神论，1828年创立梵社，后在英国为莫卧儿皇帝请愿时去世。

label.zh: 生于孟加拉拉达纳加尔

label.en: East India Company revenue official at Rangpur
label.zh: 在朗布尔任东印度公司税务官员

label.en: Settles in Calcutta; founds the Atmiya Sabha
label.zh: 定居加尔各答，创立友爱会
创立梵社

label.en: In London as envoy of the Mughal emperor Akbar II
label.zh: 作为莫卧儿皇帝阿克巴二世的使者在伦敦
卒于布里斯托尔斯泰普尔顿

sources.title: Lynn Zastoupil, Rammohun Roy and the Making of Victorian Britain (2010)
David Kopf, The Brahmo Samaj and the Shaping of the Modern Indian Mind (1979)

note: Born 1772 by the usual reckoning; some sources give 1774.

name.zh: 辨喜（斯瓦米·维韦卡南达）

summary.en: Born Narendranath Datta in Calcutta, the disciple of the mystic Ramakrishna who presented Vedanta to the West. His address to the 1893 Parliament of the World’s Religions in Chicago made him famous; he founded the Ramakrishna Mission to join spiritual life with social service.
summary.zh: 原名纳兰德拉纳特·达塔，生于加尔各答，神秘主义者罗摩克里希纳的弟子，把吠檀多哲学介绍到西方。他在1893年芝加哥世界宗教会议上的演讲使他声名鹊起；他创立罗摩克里希纳传道会，把灵修与社会服务结合起来。

label.zh: 生于加尔各答北部
在达克希内斯瓦尔拜见罗摩克里希纳

label.en: Meditates on the rock off Kanyakumari at the end of his wanderings
label.zh: 漫游印度后在科摩林角外礁石上冥想

label.en: Speaks at the Parliament of the World’s Religions, Chicago
label.zh: 在芝加哥世界宗教会议上演讲

label.en: Founds the Ramakrishna Mission in Calcutta
label.zh: 在加尔各答创立罗摩克里希纳传道会
卒于贝鲁尔修道院

role.en: Jurist, Dalit leader and chief architect of the Indian constitution
role.zh: 法学家、达利特领袖、印度宪法主要起草者

summary.en: Born into the “untouchable” Mahar caste, Ambedkar earned doctorates from Columbia and London and led the struggle against caste discrimination. As chair of the drafting committee he shaped the Constitution of India; weeks before his death he converted to Buddhism with hundreds of thousands of followers.
summary.zh: 出生于“不可接触”的马哈尔种姓，先后获得哥伦比亚大学和伦敦大学博士学位，领导反对种姓歧视的斗争。作为起草委员会主席，他主持制定了《印度宪法》；去世前数周，他与数十万追随者一起皈依佛教。

label.en: Born at the military cantonment of Mhow
label.zh: 生于姆霍军营

label.en: Studies at Columbia University, New York
label.zh: 在纽约哥伦比亚大学求学

label.en: Leads the Mahad satyagraha for access to a public tank
label.zh: 领导马哈德非暴力抗争，争取使用公共水池

label.en: Signs the Poona Pact with Gandhi at Yerwada
label.zh: 在耶拉瓦达与甘地签订《浦那协定》

label.en: Law minister; chairs the constitution’s drafting committee in Delhi
label.zh: 任法律部长，在德里主持宪法起草委员会
在那格浦尔皈依佛教
卒于德里

sources.title: Dhananjay Keer, Dr. Ambedkar: Life and Mission (3rd ed., 1971)
Christophe Jaffrelot, Dr Ambedkar and Untouchability (2005)

summary.en: Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman discovered in Calcutta in 1928 that light scattered by molecules shifts in wavelength, the Raman effect. He received the 1930 Nobel Prize in Physics, the first for an Asian scientist, and later led the Indian Institute of Science and his own institute in Bangalore.
summary.zh: 钱德拉塞卡拉·文卡塔·拉曼1928年在加尔各答发现光被分子散射后波长发生改变，即“拉曼效应”。他获得1930年诺贝尔物理学奖，是首位获此奖的亚洲科学家，后来在班加罗尔领导印度科学研究所和他自己的研究所。

label.zh: 生于蒂鲁吉拉帕利附近的蒂鲁瓦奈科伊尔

label.en: Joins the finance service in Calcutta; researches at night at the IACS
label.zh: 在加尔各答任财政官员，夜间在印度科学培育协会做研究

label.en: Voyage to England; wonders why the Mediterranean is blue
label.zh: 赴英途中思考地中海为何呈蓝色

label.en: Discovers the Raman effect at the IACS, Calcutta
label.zh: 在加尔各答印度科学培育协会发现拉曼效应
在斯德哥尔摩获诺贝尔物理学奖

label.en: Director of the Indian Institute of Science, Bangalore
label.zh: 任班加罗尔印度科学研究所所长

label.en: Dies at his Raman Research Institute, Bangalore
label.zh: 卒于班加罗尔拉曼研究所

sources.title: NobelPrize.org: Sir Chandrasekhara Venkata Raman – Biographical
G. Venkataraman, Journey into Light: Life and Science of C. V. Raman (1988)

summary.en: Leader of the Awami League whose six-point demand for East Pakistani autonomy won a landslide in 1970. Arrested on the night the Pakistani army cracked down in March 1971, he returned in January 1972 as the leader of independent Bangladesh, and was killed with most of his family in a coup in 1975.
summary.zh: 人民联盟领袖，其争取东巴基斯坦自治的“六点要求”在1970年选举中大获全胜。1971年3月巴基斯坦军队镇压当夜他被捕，1972年1月作为独立的孟加拉国领导人归国；1975年在政变中与大部分家人一同遇害。

label.zh: 生于戈帕尔甘杰的通吉帕拉

label.en: Student activist at Dhaka University in the language movement
label.zh: 在达卡大学参加语言运动

label.en: Announces the six-point programme at Lahore
label.zh: 在拉合尔提出“六点要求”

label.en: Speech of 7 March at the Ramna Racecourse, Dhaka
label.zh: 3月7日在达卡拉姆纳赛马场演讲

label.en: Tried in secret in a jail at Lyallpur (Faisalabad)
label.zh: 在莱亚尔布尔（费萨拉巴德）监狱受秘密审判

label.en: Returns to Dhaka via London and Delhi
label.zh: 经伦敦、德里返回达卡

label.en: Assassinated at his house, Road 32, Dhanmondi
label.zh: 在达恩蒙迪32号路寓所遇刺

sources.title: Sheikh Mujibur Rahman, The Unfinished Memoirs (tr. 2012)
Srinath Raghavan, 1971: A Global History of the Creation of Bangladesh (2013)

summary.en: One of the few women to rule a major Indian kingdom in her own name. Raised and styled as a son by her father Ganapatideva, she defended Warangal against the Yadavas and rebellious nobles; Marco Polo praised the justice of the queen of the Telugu country.
summary.zh: 少数以本人名义统治印度大王国的女性之一。她被父亲迦那帕蒂提婆当作儿子抚养并赐予男性称号，保卫瓦朗加尔抵御亚达瓦王朝和叛乱贵族；马可·波罗称赞这位泰卢固国度女王的公正。

label.en: Rules from Warangal, at first alongside her father
label.zh: 在瓦朗加尔执政，初与其父共治

label.en: Repels the Yadava invasion of Mahadeva
label.zh: 击退亚达瓦王摩诃提婆的入侵

label.en: Dies, apparently during the war against the rebel Ambadeva (Chandupatla inscription)
label.zh: 似于平定叛将安巴提婆的战争期间去世（钱杜帕特拉铭文）

sources.title: Cynthia Talbot, Precolonial India in Practice (2001)
Marco Polo, The Travels, book III, ch. 18 (Mutfili)
P. V. P. Sastry, The Kākatīyas of Warangal (Hyderabad, 1978)

note: No source records her birth. c. 1210 follows P. V. P. Sastry (The Kākatīyas of Warangal, 1978, p. 125), who judged her to be about eighty when she died in 1289; a marriage to Virabhadra soon after Ganapati’s conquest of Vengi in 1240 (Talbot) is also compatible with a birth in the 1210s–1220s. Popular dates such as 1259 are impossible, since she was co-regent by about 1260. The Chandupatla inscription (27 November 1289) shows she had died shortly before; older histories, which lacked it, had her reign run to 1295. Whether she died in battle is not certain.

summary.en: The Trongsa Penlop who won Bhutan’s last civil war, mediated between Britain and Tibet during the Younghusband expedition of 1904, and was elected the first hereditary king in 1907. The Treaty of Punakha (1910) let British India guide Bhutan’s foreign relations while leaving it internally independent.
summary.zh: 通萨本洛，赢得不丹最后一场内战，1904年荣赫鹏远征期间在英国与西藏之间斡旋，1907年被推举为首任世袭国王。1910年的《普那卡条约》规定不丹对外关系听取英属印度意见，内政则保持独立。

label.zh: 生于布姆唐的旺迪确林宫

label.en: Wins the battle of Changlimithang, ending the civil wars
label.zh: 赢得昌里米塘之战，结束内战

label.en: Mediator with the Younghusband expedition at Lhasa
label.zh: 随荣赫鹏远征军至拉萨斡旋

label.en: Elected first Druk Gyalpo at Punakha Dzong
label.zh: 在普那卡宗堡被推举为首任龙王

label.en: Signs the Treaty of Punakha with British India
label.zh: 与英属印度签订《普那卡条约》

sources.title: Michael Aris, The Raven Crown: The Origins of Buddhist Monarchy in Bhutan (1994)

note: Changlimithang is dated 1885 in most Bhutanese accounts (some give 1886). He died in August 1926 (21 or 26 August in different sources).
